_doc: The Remand Program's heavy-lift drone that brings supply lifts in (ProgramDrone, SupplyDrops; ADR-0023). It comes in approach_m out at cruise_alt along a bearing fixed by the world seed and the drop, brakes over the last brake_m to a hover over the spot (SupplyDrops.RELEASE_HEIGHT up), lets the canister go release_after_s into the hover, hovers hover_s in all, then flies on and climbs to depart_alt depart_m away. Its noise over the spot carries hover_noise metres on the ground (stimulus). The landing spot needs landing_clearance m clear of player structures and solid props and landing_tree_clearance m clear of tree trunks (a crown snags the chute). Metres, m/s, seconds.
